label: Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products / Brands / Display)
terms_note: Amazon Ads API access requires an approved Login-with-Amazon application (docs portal); advertiser terms not read this session

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Login with Amazon; Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId + Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope profile header)
sdks: https://github.com/amzn/ads-advanced-tools-docs (official Postman collection + Amazon Marketing Stream CloudFormation)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Amazon Ads API: Sponsored Products / Brands / Display / TV, reporting v3, DSP reports, creative
auth: 1. Create a **Login with Amazon** security profile and apply for Amazon Ads API access (approval by Amazon; the user's advertiser account must be in an Amazon Ads-supported marketplace).
3. Exchange the code / refresh token at `https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token` → `access_token` (short-lived; environment tracks `token_expires_at`) + `refresh_token`.

4. `GET /v2/profiles` → pick the advertiser profile; every subsequent call sends `Authorization: Bearer`, `Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId: <client_id>`, `Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope: <profileId>`; DSP uses `dspAccountId`, manager accounts `manager_account_id`.

endpoints.notes: `campaigns[]{name, state, budget{budget, budgetType}, targetingType, startDate, dynamicBidding}`
`campaigns[]{name, budget, budgetType, bidding}`; creatives via asset ids

endpoints.call: POST /sd/campaigns` · `GET /sd/campaigns`; SD ad groups / product ads / creatives

endpoints.notes: `configuration{adProduct, reportTypeId, groupBy[], columns[], timeUnit}, startDate, endDate`
`adType, filters[]` — first-party audience upload is DSP-only (not in the SP/SB/SD collection)

endpoints.call: Amazon Marketing Stream (SQS / Firehose subscriptions), AMC (`/amc/*`), Exports (`/exports`)

reference.limits: - Access is gated on Amazon approving the LWA application for the Ads API; Amazon publishes per-endpoint throttling (429 with `Retry-After`) in the Advanced Tools Center (TODO(verify): exact numbers, JS-only page). - Free API; the advertiser pays for ads only. Test accounts ("Test accounts" folder) exist for development. - Conversions upload: not in the sponsored-ads API (attribution is native to Amazon); AMC handles advanced measurement.
mcp_sdk: Official: Postman collection + environment, Amazon Marketing Stream CloudFormation template — https://github.com/amzn/ads-advanced-tools-docs. No official SDK or MCP server found there.

sandbox.notes: Amazon Ads documents no separate sandbox host (the old /API/docs/guides/sandbox page answers 'The requested document was not found'; the API overview lists only advertising-api, -eu and -fe). Testing uses test accounts on the production hosts: create one with the test account API (scope advertising::test:create_account), then use its profileId as Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope (config profile_id). Test accounts serve no ads, so reports and performance data are empty.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Login with Amazon client id of the app approved for the Amazon Ads API; also sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId header.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The LWA client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: LWA refresh token from the advertiser's consent (scope advertising::campaign_management); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it at https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token.

config_fields.name: api_host
config_fields.help: Regional Amazon Ads API host: advertising-api.amazon.com (North America), advertising-api-eu.amazon.com (Europe) or advertising-api-fe.amazon.com (Far East).

config_fields.name: profile_id
config_fields.help: Advertising profile id (one per advertiser and marketplace, from GET /v2/profiles), sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope header.

me.note: GET /v2/profiles/{profileId}: the configured profile {profileId, countryCode, currencyCode, timezone, accountInfo {id, type, name, marketplaceStringId}}.

list_accounts.note: GET /v2/profiles (apiProgram=campaign, accessLevel=edit by default): one profile per advertiser and marketplace in the configured region. `id` is the profileId used as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope; country is raw.countryCode.

list_campaigns.note: Sponsored Products v3 POST /sp/campaigns/list with Content-Type/Accept application/vnd.spCampaign.v3+json and {maxResults, stateFilter: {include: [status]}} (ENABLED, PAUSED, ARCHIVED). The advertiser is the configured profile_id (Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope header): account_id is not sent and should be that profile id. `budget` is budget.budget in the profile currency (budgetType DAILY). Paging is by nextToken; only the first page is returned.

update_budget.note: PUT /sp/campaigns {campaigns: [{campaignId, budget: {budget, budgetType: DAILY}}]} in the profile's currency (`currency` is ignored). The API answers 207 Multi-Status with campaigns.success[] / campaigns.error[]; a rejected update (error only) is reported as invalid_input.

pause_resume.note: PUT /sp/campaigns {campaigns: [{campaignId, state: PAUSED|ENABLED}]}; 207 Multi-Status, the success item carries the updated campaign (status = its state); a rejected update is reported as invalid_input.

not_offered.get_report: Reporting v3 is asynchronous: POST /reporting/reports creates a report, GET /reporting/reports/{reportId} is polled until COMPLETED, and the rows are a gzipped JSON file at a pre-signed URL; the runtime makes one call per tool.

evidence: probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
